pivot_note: pivot: pixels from the PNG's top-left; model_xy: where the pivot sits at rest (model units, feet at y 0)

grass_back.desc: tall far blades behind Luigi's body and head, reaching above the cap; pinned to the body card, drawn behind everything of his

grass_front.desc: the near blades over his body and legs, up to the moustache on the face side; his shoes show below y 1; pinned to the body card, in front of the body

grass_front_sway.desc: the near blades, swaying back (walk, rustle); pinned to the body card, in front of the body

grass_hood.desc: a mop of blades over the cap, framing his face; pinned to the head card, in front of the cap

grass_hood_sway.desc: the crown of blades, swaying back; pinned to the head card, in front of the cap

pin_note: model_xy: the pin in c_luigi's bind pose; pin_on_part: the same point in the texels of the part it pins to
